ShopBot Index › Which stores declare UCP checkout?

Which stores declare UCP checkout?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 947 of the 951 stores that publish a UCP profile declare checkout (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout). Big retailers that declare it are Asprey, Boozt, Debenhams PLC, FAO Schwarz, Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Hamleys, IKEA, Mexx, On AG, Pepco, Poundland, Quiksilver, The Body Shop and Zellers. Declaring checkout is a line in that profile, not proof that an AI agent can complete a purchase.

4 of the 951 stores that publish a UCP profile do not declare checkout: American Eagle Outfitters, Farfetch, Media Expert and Zooplus AG.

Frequently asked questions

Which stores declare UCP checkout?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 947 of the 951 stores that publish a UCP profile declare checkout (dev.ucp.shopping.checkout). Big retailers that declare it are Asprey, Boozt, Debenhams PLC, FAO Schwarz, Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Hamleys, IKEA, Mexx, On AG, Pepco, Poundland, Quiksilver, The Body Shop and Zellers. Declaring checkout is a line in that profile, not proof that an AI agent can complete a purchase.

Which stores publish a UCP profile and do not declare checkout?

4 of the 951 stores that publish a UCP profile do not declare checkout: American Eagle Outfitters, Farfetch, Media Expert and Zooplus AG.

Does declaring checkout mean AI agents can buy?

No. Declaring checkout is a line in the published profile, not proof that an AI agent can complete a purchase. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.
